ledger.claim: The trip record carries a driver arrival event for this trip at 2026-08-06T12:29:55+08:00, which satisfies limb (a) of the baseline no-show test. The marker was pressed after the vehicle had come to rest at the pickup, not on the way there.

The driver was inside the arrival radius before and at that marker: his closest approach to the pickup pin on this trip was 18.1 m, and his first qualifying in-geofence fix is at 12:30:00, five seconds after the marker, with recorded accuracies around the waiting window of 6.1 m to 11.9 m, comfortably inside the 25 m filter. Limb (b) of POL-NS-01 and the POL-NS-02 proximity test for the STANDARD radius of 50 m are therefore both met. The GPS trace I cite is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE; the impairment concerns the 168 s outage later in the window and does not touch the pre-outage fixes that establish arrival.

The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05. At the marker timestamp the trace places the driver 18 to 29 m from the pickup pin, nowhere near the 300 m threshold, and stationary at the kerb, so there is no basis to recompute the waiting clock and the fee is not defeated as a false-arrival event. The GPS trace cited is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and the impairment bears on the later outage, not on the driver's position at the marker.

The driver held position inside the geofence from the first qualifying in-geofence fix at 12:30:00 until he cancelled at 12:38:20 - a span of 500 seconds, against a free waiting period in force of 300 seconds taken from trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec and against the 300 second STANDARD minimum dwell. The trace's own run-splitting reports a 220 s first run and an 80 s shortfall, but that computation treats the 168 s recording outage from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 as if the driver had driven away: the trace holds no fix placing him outside the radius at any point, the excursion is recorded with fix_count 0 and max_distance_m null, and POL-NS-08(b) makes a gap of that kind an impairment of the trace rather than a finding of departure. The GPS trace I rely on is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE, and I disclose that the finding is a continuity argument across an unobserved interval, which is why I do not rest limb (c) on the trace alone. The driver does not seek accumulation under POL-NS-06(i) - his case is a single continuous presence interrupted only in the recording.

The chat log, which is COMPLETE at weight 1.0, independently corroborates the driver's presence during the outage: at 12:35:10, inside the unobserved interval, he sent 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you', which the admissibility report itself describes as the only unimpaired evidence of what he was doing during the gap and as showing him still working the pickup. Because an artifact other than the impaired trace carries the deciding fact of dwell, the POL-GEN-02(2) confidence cap is the maximum of the weights (1.0) rather than the minimum (0.39), and the PARTIAL_REFUND ceiling POL-NS-08 sets for sole impaired evidence is not engaged. The GPS trace cited alongside is impaired at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

The trip record's own wait_time_min of 8.4 minutes - 504 seconds, on an artifact at weight 1.0 and independent of the exported GPS trace - measures the same waiting period and is itself longer than the 300 second minimum, so the dwell finding does not stand or fall on the impaired trace alone.

Limb (d) is satisfied: the record shows no boarding event, started_at and ended_at are both null, and the trip was terminated by the driver at 12:38:20 under cancellation_reason_code RIDER_NO_SHOW, well after the required dwell had elapsed.

The rider's exoneration route under POL-NS-04 fails at its own limb (b). The rider's coordinating message at 12:31:02 was answered by the driver at 12:31:20, eighteen seconds later and far inside the 120 second window, and he messaged again at 12:35:10; the clause does not apply regardless of the content of the reply, and trip_record.in_app_calls need not be reached to defeat it.

POL-NS-03 has no application on these facts: the wrong-entrance route fires only where the driver's stationary fixes lie outside the POL-NS-02 arrival radius, and this driver's fixes lie 18 to 29 m from the pin, inside the 50 m STANDARD radius. The record also shows registered_pickup_points of 1, so the pin-ambiguity goodwill in limb (ii) could not arise even if the fixes had fallen outside the radius. The GPS trace cited is IMPAIRED at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE.

No POL-NS-09 trigger fires. No two admissible artifacts contradict each other on arrival, dwell or rider presence - the trace, the trip record and the chat all place the driver at the kerb across the window. rider_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d and driver_profile.disputes_with_counterparty_90d are both 0, so limb (c) is not met; the POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is 1, below the limb (d) threshold of 3. Because the deciding fact is not carried by impaired evidence alone, POL-GEN-02(2) does not push confidence below the 0.70 floor and limb (e) is not engaged.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied on all four limbs and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.00 net cancellation fee in force, that is SGD 3.20, and the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the required count of 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 146 is 0.014, below the required rate of 0.08. Both limbs must hold and neither does, so compensation is not withheld. I cite those two profile fields only for the test POL-NS-07 names, as POL-GEN-01 requires, and rely on no other profile field as a ground of decision.

The outcome the policy produces here is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, not NO_ACTION. POL-NS-07 states that where compensation is paid the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and that amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd, so the charged SGD 4.00 stands as it presently is (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00) and the driver is paid SGD 3.20. On this rider-filed dispute, NO_ACTION would leave the charge in place as well, but the ruling value that names this case's outcome is DRIVER_COMPENSATION.

ruling.explanation:
Both parties: the SGD 4.00 no-show cancellation fee stands, and the driver is paid SGD 3.20 (80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 net fee in force, per POL-NS-07).

On the rider's case. Your central claim is that the trace shows only 220 seconds of continuous in-geofence presence (12:30:00 to 12:33:40) against the 300-second free waiting period in force (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec = 300), so POL-NS-01(c) fails and POL-NS-06 refunds the fee in full. I do not accept it. EV-GPS-00211 is impaired at weight 0.39 with issue codes GPS_GAP_LONG_INSIDE_WINDOW and LOW_COVERAGE: the 168-second gap from 12:33:40 to 12:36:28 falls inside the waiting window and exceeds the 120-second threshold in POL-NS-08(b), so the trace alone cannot show what the driver did across it. But the trace is not the only evidence for the deciding fact. The chat log EV-CHAT-00211 (COMPLETE, weight 1.0) carries the driver's message MSG-00211-004, sent at 12:35:10 - inside the gap, and ten seconds after the 300-second point measured from the first qualifying fix at 12:30:00 - reading 'boss still here waiting ah, cannot see you'. That is a contemporaneous record made from inside the stretch the trace left unobserved, lying between readings the trace admitted, so it bridges the gap. Under POL-GEN-02(2) the confidence cap is therefore the maximum of the independent carriers (1.0), not the trace's 0.39, and the POL-NS-08 direction that a sole impaired carrier caps the ruling at PARTIAL_REFUND and escalates under POL-NS-09 is not engaged: the impaired trace is not the only evidence for the deciding fact. On the admitted readings - in-radius at 18.1 to 29.3 m from the pin before the gap, and in the same place after it - and on that bridge, the driver held the pickup continuously from 12:30:00 to his 12:38:20 cancellation, 500 seconds against the 300 required.

Your further point that the derived 500-second 'longest qualifying run' is a first-fix-to-last-fix envelope and that the two runs can be joined only under POL-NS-06(i) is rejected. POL-NS-06(i) governs a driver who actually leaves and re-enters the arrival radius; this trace records no fix placing him outside the radius, the recorded excursion carries a fix count of 0 and a null maximum distance, and the trace notes say he is in the same place after the outage. This is one continuous presence with a recording gap, not two intervals needing summation, so the MISSING advisory (EV-ADVIS-00211-01, weight 0.0, issue MISSING_ARTIFACT) removes nothing the driver needs and no summing or goodwill question arises.

Your rider-contact route under POL-NS-04 fails at its own limb (b): the driver answered your 12:31:02 message at 12:31:20, eighteen seconds later and well inside the 120-second window, which defeats the clause whatever the reply said. POL-NS-03 does not apply either: the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and trip_record.registered_pickup_points is 1. Your point that prior_no_show_flags may not be substituted for rider_profile.no_show_disputes_30d is correct and I do not use it: the trailing-30-day counter is 1, below POL-NS-09(d)'s threshold of 3, and both disputes_with_counterparty_90d counters are 0, so no escalation trigger fires.

On the driver's case. All four limbs of POL-NS-01 hold: (a) the trip record carries an arrival event at 12:29:55; (b) the trace places you inside the 50 m STANDARD radius (closest approach 18.1 m), and the marker is not false under POL-NS-05, you being stationary at the kerb, not over 300 m from the pin and not travelling at 15 km/h; (c) the dwell was served at 500 seconds; (d) there is no boarding event, started_at and ended_at are null, and the trip was terminated by you at 12:38:20 under RIDER_NO_SHOW after the dwell elapsed. POL-NS-07 fixes your payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.00 net fee = SGD 3.20, payable because the anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below the required 4) and 2/146 = 0.014 (below the required 0.08); both limbs must hold and neither does. Those are the only profile fields I use, as POL-GEN-01 requires. The trip record's wait_time_min of 8.4 minutes (504 seconds) is consistent but I do not rest on it, as it is platform telemetry that may be computed from the same measurement as the trace.

POL-GEN-03: on a DRIVER_COMPENSATION ruling amount_sgd carries the same figure as driver_compensation_sgd, so both are SGD 3.20; the rider's charge stands (payment_status CHARGED, refund_issued_sgd 0.00). The monetary effect (SGD 3.20) is below the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes on issue. No clause produces a referral: POL-NS-05 does not fire and the reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW is correctly selected. Four claims were discarded at the mechanical check for citing impaired artifacts without disclosing the impairment (EV-GPS-00211 at 0.39; EV-ADVIS-00211-01 at 0.0); they are listed in the audit record. This ruling is provisional and either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and 3 of the 4 drafts agreed on this ruling, so it is carried, not unanimous (vote agreement 0.75).
